approval.decision: Adopt Story r4 and Location r2 LIGHT colors. Use each exact light anchor/LUT/class and role HEX unchanged on dark, with the same data direction; no derived dark formulas. Existing categorical palettes and decorative gradients retain their own contracts.

precedence: Complete standalone LDS 0.9.7 normative and exact assets for adopted 0.9.7 work
Separate applicable product Add-on or Location profile binds the exact current base
Historical packages apply only to explicitly pinned historical work

sourceRules.COLOR-01: Use exact color-srgb-10 analytical tables and approved 17-value Story vocabulary. Original categorical and decorative roles remain separate.
sourceRules.DATAVIZ-02: Three explicit anchors at 0/20/40; use exact approved 41 samples and classes 3/5/7/9. A sequential midpoint changes hue, not numerical direction. Start colors are semantic near-whites, not a compulsory universal cream.
sourceRules.DATAVIZ-03: Analytical light and dark anchors, LUTs and classes are byte-for-byte equal in numerical values. Preserve value direction. No dark derivation, inversion, recoloring or theme-dependent numerical normalization. Use labels, borders and a neutral backplate for actual-surface contrast.
sourceRules.DATAVIZ-04: Every delivered analytical sample must avoid the applicable earth and violet windows; pink is allowed. Domain, unit and redundant cues remain mandatory.
sourceRules.DATAVIZ-05: Stable 10 IDs and cues; exact unchanged light values plus approved dark soft/vivid/ink. Deprecated v5 aliases prohibited.
sourceRules.EVID-05: Six value states: measured, measured_zero, no_data, out_of_scope, suppressed, not_yet; finite nonzero, zero, or null respectively.
sourceRules.SOCIALFMT-01: Full inherited sidecar contract admits square1080x1080 and OG1200x630 using the new schema; creative hash and dimensions required.
sourceRules.GOV-01/RELEASE-01: This owner-approved distribution is unsigned. An artifact may pin this exact channel and report scoped checks, but MUST NOT fabricate or inherit a signed 0.9.7 receipt or call itself fully conformant from package verification.

analytical.domainAndThresholds: consumer supplied; never silently normalized or clamped
analytical.outlierPolicy: consumer must declare reject, extend with approved scale, or explicit end-bin; never silently clamp
analytical.divergingMidpoint: must be meaningful and named; no equal-brightness arm claim

sequentialAnchors.middleHue: distinct from the end hue, never merely its lighter tint
sequentialAnchors.constructionOnly: authoring construction only; consumers use exact LUT samples
sequentialAnchors.notDiverging: The middle colour is a perceptual turn, not zero, balance or a second data direction.

themeInvariant.contrastRemedy: Keep data HEX; use labels, meaningful boundaries or a neutral backplate. Test actual surfaces and sizes. No automatic 3:1, CVD or full accessibility claim.

categorical.fillSeparation: >=1px border.default or ink outline; do not imply all light fills meet3:1

brand.ijjiIdentity: ground.mist for light; #59C7E8 to #3BD3CB for dark. Retired warm product aliases must not be used as identity.

verificationBounds: Package parity and analytical math are automated.
Rendering, actual surface contrast, native Thai copy, source truth, threshold semantics, CVD/grayscale usability and each output format require artifact review.
No claim of signed 0.9.7 release, complete conformance, universal platform enforcement or team installation.
Inherited open governance/product-icon/motif/signing follow-ups remain open unless specifically resolved here.
Dark numerical colors intentionally equal light values; actual-surface contrast and CVD usability are artifact checks, not universal package guarantees.
